claim_boundary: Repository creation, migration, workflow success, and review intake do not adopt QTR-CHARTER-00, promote QTR-SIG-WP00, certify mathematics, establish quantum advantage, or validate hardware claims.

Axiomatist.obligation: Lock programme domain, evidence classes, promise and oracle semantics, norms, errors, and adoption boundary.

Cartographer.obligation: Map QTR against GCL authority surfaces, QSP and QSVT lanes, adversary and span-program methodology, and mathematical certification dependencies.

Grammarian.obligation: Check identifiers, definitions, symbols, schema vocabulary, state names, claim language, and cross-document consistency.

Verifier.obligation: Replay identity comparison, packet validation, tests, baseline evidence, QTR validation, and GCL conformance on exact commits.

Adversary.obligation: Search for hidden preprocessing, oracle leakage, vanishing gaps, inaccessible encodings, concealed polynomial degree, weak baselines, and authority ambiguity.

Formalist.obligation: Separate definitions, executable assertions, finite evidence, theorem obligations, and future formalization boundaries.

Amanuensis.obligation: Verify source, transport, target, workflow, manifest, migration, provenance, and stable-record identities.

Referee.obligation: Review the exact final adoption head after all other office records and issue promote, revise, reject, or terminate.

downstream_gate: QTR-SIG-WP01, QTR-SIG-WP02, and finite-instance QTR-SIG-WP03 remain unauthorized until Referee promotion.
